log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Duration (Days)
log_retention_days.description: The number of days security logs are retained and remain accessible for forensic investigation before archival or deletion, as configured in the logging policy or platform settings.

retention_policy_enforced.title: Retention Policy Actively Enforced
retention_policy_enforced.description: Whether the log retention policy is actively enforced through automated controls (e.g., lifecycle rules, platform configuration) rather than relying solely on manual processes.

log_types_covered.title: Log Types Covered by Retention Policy
log_types_covered.description: The categories of security-relevant logs subject to the retention policy (e.g., authentication, network, endpoint, application, access).

applicable_compliance_frameworks.title: Applicable Compliance Frameworks
applicable_compliance_frameworks.description: List of regulatory or contractual frameworks the organization is subject to that mandate specific log retention durations (e.g., PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOX, GDPR, FedRAMP).

retention_policy_documented.title: Retention Policy Formally Documented
retention_policy_documented.description: Whether the log retention policy is formally documented in a written policy or configuration file, approved, referencing specific regulatory retention requirements, and accessible for audit review.

archival_integrity_verified.title: Archived Log Integrity Verification Enabled
archival_integrity_verified.description: Whether archived logs undergo integrity verification (e.g., checksums, WORM storage, cryptographic signing) to ensure they are tamper-evident and admissible as audit evidence.

archival_integrity_mechanism.title: Archival Integrity Mechanism
archival_integrity_mechanism.description: The mechanism used to ensure integrity of logs once moved to archival storage.

archival_storage_type.title: Archival Storage Type
archival_storage_type.description: The type of storage backend used for archived logs.

archival_retention_lock_enforced.title: Archival Retention Lock Enforced
archival_retention_lock_enforced.description: Whether a retention lock (compliance or governance mode) is enforced on the archival storage to prevent deletion or modification of archived logs.

integrity_failure_alerting.title: Integrity Failure Alerting Configured
integrity_failure_alerting.description: Whether alerts are configured to notify security teams when archival integrity verification fails or log volume anomalies are detected.

storage_tier_transitions_defined.title: Storage Tier Transitions Defined
storage_tier_transitions_defined.description: Whether explicit transition rules are configured for moving logs between hot, warm, and cold storage tiers, including time-based or size-based triggers for each transition.

tier_overlap_or_continuity_guarantee.title: Tier Continuity Guarantee Method
tier_overlap_or_continuity_guarantee.description: The method used to ensure logs remain queryable with no gap during transition between storage tiers.

minimum_hot_tier_retention_days.title: Minimum Hot Tier Retention (Days)
minimum_hot_tier_retention_days.description: The number of days logs are retained in the hot (immediately queryable) storage tier before transitioning to warm or cold storage.

retention_policy_defined.title: Retention Policy Defined
retention_policy_defined.description: Whether a formal log retention policy with defined storage duration and archival conditions is in place and actively enforced in the logging system configuration.

archival_trigger_configured.title: Archival Trigger Configured
archival_trigger_configured.description: Whether automated archival triggers (e.g., storage threshold, time-based) are configured to prevent log loss due to storage exhaustion.

retention_policy_versioned.title: Retention Policy Version Controlled
retention_policy_versioned.description: Whether the retention policy document or configuration is stored in a version control system (e.g., Git) or has explicit version/revision tracking with change history.

enforcement_scope.title: Policy Enforcement Scope
enforcement_scope.description: Whether the documented retention policy is consistently enforced across all log sources or only partially applied.

log_integrity_verification_enabled.title: Log Integrity Verification Enabled
log_integrity_verification_enabled.description: Indicates whether cryptographic integrity verification (e.g., hashing, digital signatures, or write-once storage) is applied to retained logs to detect unauthorized modification or deletion.

log_access_control_restricted.title: Log Storage Access Restricted to Authorized Personnel
log_access_control_restricted.description: Indicates whether access to raw log storage (deletion, modification) is restricted to a minimal set of authorized roles, preventing unauthorized tampering.

archived_log_retrieval_sla_minutes.title: Archived Log Retrieval SLA (Minutes)
archived_log_retrieval_sla_minutes.description: Maximum time in minutes defined in policy for retrieving archived logs upon request during incident response.

retrieval_procedure_documented.title: Retrieval Procedure Documented
retrieval_procedure_documented.description: Whether a formal, written procedure exists describing how to retrieve archived logs, including responsible roles and steps.

retrieval_mechanism_type.title: Retrieval Mechanism Type
retrieval_mechanism_type.description: The technical mechanism used to retrieve archived logs, indicating automation level and expected retrieval speed.
